subject: Saving state of Shiny app to be restored later

messages.author: ff699f651734499a
messages.subject: Saving state of Shiny app to be restored later
parts:
Hello,

I have a shiny application with many tabs and many widgets on each tab. It is a data driven application so the data is tied to every tab. I can save the application using image.save() and create a .RData file for later use. The issue I am having how can I get the state restored for the widgets? If the user has checked boxes, selected radio buttons and specified base line values in list boxes can I set those within a load() step? I have found libraries such as shinyURL and shinystore but is there a direct way to set the environment back to when the write.image was done? I am not sure where to even start so I can't post code....


Regards,

Rich

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Saving state of Shiny app to be restored later
parts:
There are a variety of functions in Shiny that begin with "update", this will let you manually update most of the input widgets to the appropriate values.

This example might help: https://github.com/jcheng5/shiny-resume
